jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer | Cybersecurity / AI | Hybrid, Amsterdam

Networking. Hacking. Streaming.

If you’re a strong backend engineer with hands-on experience in at least two of those three
, I’d like a conversation.

I’m working with a cybersecurity business where that combination will get put to proper use. There’s quite a bit I can tell you about what they’re building, but some of the more interesting detail is better saved for a call.

What I can say: there are substantial volumes of data, thousands of things happening concurrently and systems that need to work out what to do next based on what they’ve just found.

Making all of that work reliably is where you come in 🤞🏻

The work

You’ll build backend services and tooling, working closely with engineers and security specialists to turn complex ideas into working software.

Some days that means building a new capability. Others, working out why a database is struggling under load, where a pipeline is getting held up or how to stop one failed task causing a much bigger headache.

You’ll be involved in:

High-concurrency services and tools
, where performance matters.
Event-driven systems and streaming pipelines
, processing information at scale.
APIs and backend services
that other parts of the platform depend on.
AI-driven workflows
involving multiple steps, decisions and things that can go wrong.
Architecture and database improvements
, with ownership of getting them into production.

They want someone who’ll have an opinion. Spot something that could work better? Bring it up. Got an idea worth testing? Be prepared to get stuck in and see it through.

The person

You’ve built and operated distributed systems, you’re a strong developer in Go, C# or a similar language
, and you can talk through the decisions you made when things got complicated.

Then there’s the two-out-of-three bit:

Networking:
you understand protocols, connections and how systems communicate beneath the application layer.
Hacking:
you’ve investigated vulnerabilities, tested how systems can be exploited or built security tooling.
Streaming:
you’ve built systems that continuously process data or events, and dealt with the challenges that come with scale.

At least two is a requirement. All three would be very interesting.

I’d also like to hear about your experience with concurrency, asynchronous processing and relational databases. Python, Kafka, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL performance or autonomous agents
would give us more to talk about.

And if you’ve built your own tools, contributed to open source or disappeared down a technical rabbit hole because you needed to know how something worked, tell me about it. That stuff is useful here.

What’s in it for you?

Proper ownership, a technically demanding product and the chance to work closely with people who know their security.

There’s room to influence how things are built and grow towards Staff Engineering or Engineering Management
, depending on where you want to take it.

Equity, hybrid working in Amsterdam and loads of flexibility. And I mean that.

If you’ve read this and thought, “That sounds like me,” give me a shout. I’ll fill in the gaps.

jobs.title: Senior/Sr. Principal Automation Engineer, Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

About The Katwijk Site

This position starts with a 12-month contract, with the intention of offering a permanent contract based on mutual fit. (Dienstverband: tijdelijk met uitzicht op vast)

Eli Lilly is investing €2.6 billion in a new state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Katwijk, Netherlands. This facility will produce oral medicines for cardiometabolic health, neuroscience, oncology, and immunology, incorporating next-generation manufacturing technologies including dock-to-dock automation, paperless manufacturing, and process analytical technology while achieving carbon neutrality and zero waste to landfills.

Position Description

The Senior/Sr. Principal Automation Engineer - Quality Assurance serves as the site subject matter expert for Computer System Validation (CSV), automation compliance, and data integrity for GMP computerized systems including DCS, SCADA, MES, Historians, Building Management Systems and supporting automation platforms.

This role provides strategic leadership for the validation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of GMP computerized and automation systems supporting Oral Solid Dose (OSD) manufacturing operations at the Katwijk site.

In addition, this role is also responsible for the definition, implementation, and maintenance of data integrity controls in GMP regulated computer systems. This includes working with Automation, QC labs, and Tech@Lilly persons to develop validation strategies for the approach to computer system validation in compliance with corporate standards; consultation and interpretation on applying and right-sizing validation requirements; maintaining corporate and site computer systems standards and practices; participating in internal and external Regulatory agency inspections; conducting evaluations of internal or supplier quality practices; maintenance of inspectional readiness; and external benchmarking of computer system validation practices. Finally, this position will leverage an understanding of GMP data flows (electronic and paper), the application of data management/integrity principles in the site's processes, and validation/maintenance requirements to support regulatory compliance, consistency, and sustainment.

Responsibilities

Deliver on CSV Processes and Data Integrity Sustainability

Establish and maintain CSQ support and DI sustainability processes.
Drive appropriate consistency in CSQ and DI controls.

Deliver Projects and Programs

Serve as the site subject matter expert for automation system validation including DCS, SCADA, MES, Historian, Building Management Systems and other GMP computerized systems.
Provide strategic leadership for CSV activities associated with automation systems throughout design, implementation, qualification, operation and retirement.
Lead the development and implementation of site CSV strategies and governance models to ensure the ongoing validated state of GMP computerized systems throughout their lifecycle.
Partner with Automation, Engineering, Quality and Tech@Lilly teams to ensure GMP compliance, data integrity and maintenance of validated automation systems.
Support commissioning, qualification and validation activities for automated manufacturing systems and equipment.

Grow Capabilities And Knowledge

Mentor others in DI and CSV-related roles.
Grow capabilities of those performing DI CSV activities.

Maintain Inspection Readiness

Provide consulting and interpretation on Corporate Computer Systems/Data Integrity standards and practices as implemented at the Katwijk site.
Provide cross-functional technical leadership in the event of serious quality-related issues with computer systems or data integrity.
Monitor current state of inspection-readiness.
Escalate issues appropriately.

Streamline and Continuously Improve

Promote common process and best practice across functions.
Identify systemic issues and trends across functions and drive improvement activity.
Understand the external environment/best practices and bring external learning back to Lilly.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Life Sciences, or a technology-related field.
Minimum of 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical automation, computer system validation (CSV), quality assurance, engineering, or related GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.
Experience supporting API and/or Oral Solid Dose (OSD) manufacturing operations.
Experience with automation platforms, manufacturing control systems and computerized system lifecycle management.
Candidates must have current authorisation to work in the European Union.

Additional Preferences

Direct experience with Computer Systems Validation (GAMP5) and data integrity basic principles (ALCOA+).
Previous experience in GMP or GLP environments.
Demonstrated strong oral and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal interaction skills.
Proven ability to influence quality peers, IT SMEs, and upper management.
Previous experience in Business Quality Assurance and Automation.
Understanding of process development and/or improvement (e.g. Six Sigma).
Knowledge of Lilly business area and its impact to products and patients.
Experience with automation systems including DCS, SCADA, MES, Historians, PLCs and Building Management Systems.
Experience supporting commissioning, qualification and validation of automation systems in greenfield pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities.
Demonstrated expertise in GAMP5, Data Integrity, ALCOA+, and computerized system lifecycle management.
Experience leading cross-functional CSV and automation compliance initiatives.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is

€60,000 - €99,000

Full-time equivalent employees may also be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a pension plan; vacation benefits; eligibility for healthcare benefits; flexible benefits (if applicable) life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities). Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

jobs.title: Technisch Solution Architect OPM
jobs.description:
Over de functie

In het kort: Je gaat als technisch solution architect de brug slaan tussen business en IT, complexe softwareoplossingen ontwerpen in een Azure/DevOps-omgeving en teams coachen bij het verbeteren van architectuur, automatisering en softwarekwaliteit.

Dit ga je doen als Technisch Solution Architect bij OPM

Technisch Solution Architect Ontwerpen en Plannen Materieel (OPM): bouw mee aan de digitale ruggengraat van de treinreis

Werk op het snijvlak van business en IT in een domein waar een grote digitalisering gaande is.
Werk mee aan het oplossen van de complexe logistieke puzzels binnen het spoordomein.
Werk aan een duurzame samenleving waarin treinvervoer vanuit milieuoogpunt en door verstedelijking steeds belangrijker wordt.

Pieter: “Het is supertof om aan software bij te dragen waardoor Nederland bereikbaar blijft.”

Dit ga je doen als Technisch Solution Architect bij OPM

Als onze solution architect sla jij de brug tussen de businessprocessen en de IT. Je bent actief op de werkvloer tussen en met onze teams. Op basis van de businesswensen ontwerp je samen met de lead developers de techniek en functionaliteit voor de realisatie van complexe onderdelen. De techniek is hierbij vooral jouw aandachtspunt. Daarbij houd je rekening met kaders en doelstellingen als standaardisatie, schaalbaarheid, herbruikbaarheid, performance, security en beschikbaarheid.

In afstemming met de andere (solution-/lead-) architecten in het cluster ontwikkel jij je toekomstvisie op de positie van onze softwarecomponenten in het bredere applicatielandschap van NS. Jij draagt er zorg voor dat onze (high-level) oplossingsrichtingen in lijn zijn met de wet- en regelgeving en de NS- architectuurkaders. Je blijft op de hoogte van de ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en bepaalt impact van veranderingen op (lopende) projecten. Uiteraard ben jij ook een kenner en voorvechter van onze geprefereerde manier van werken: we werken in een Agile framework (SAFe) en we zetten vol in op DevOps zaken zoals Continuous Delivery en Continuous Integration.

Een Greep Uit Jouw Dagelijkse Werkzaamheden

Ontwerpen van (high-level) functionele en technische oplossingsrichtingen, in lijn met de gestelde eisen, samen met de lead developers.
Adviseren over gekozen oplossingen bij stakeholders zoals de Product Owners, IT lead en Lead Solution Architect.
Regie nemen op en richting geven aan de voor de technische architectuur benodigde deliverables (denk hierbij bijvoorbeeld aan de inrichting van de Cloud omgeving zowel binnen als buiten ons domein).
De teams adviseren over en coachen in hun automatiseringsslagen met als doel de continue verbetering van de werkwijze, de softwarekwaliteit en de ontwikkelsnelheid.
Documenteren en controleren van opgeleverde architectuur- en engineeringproducten.
Uitdragen van de doelarchitectuur en architectuur-roadmap van het materieel planningsdomein.

Onze organisatie is continu in beweging. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een solution architect die niet alleen beschikt over een solide basis aan kennis en vaardigheden, maar ook potentie heeft om te leren en er plezier in heeft om zich aan te passen aan nieuwe situaties.

Hier ga je werken

Het cluster Ontwerpen en Plannen Materieel (OPM) is onderdeel van IT Operatie resultaatgebied 5. Dit resultaatgebied verzorgt de ontwikkeling en beheer van complexe IT-systemen die nodig zijn om een treindienst uit te voeren. Denk hierbij aan plannen en bijsturen van personeel, materieel en rangeren.

Binnen cluster OPM werken op dit moment drie agile ontwikkel teams aan de ontwikkeling van de nieuwe applicatie Maple, die het nieuwe proces van de materieelplanning moet gaan ondersteunen. Daarnaast staan we op het punt om twee nieuwe teams op te starten om nieuwe applicaties te gaan ontwikkelen. Dit zijn het Dienstregelingsportaal (voor het distribueren en verrijken van de dienstregeling van Prorail binnen NS) en de Materieelmodule (voor het maken van het MaterieelParkPlan). Daarnaast wordt in het cluster gewerkt aan grote NS-initiatieven (zoals Fundamenteel Spoor en ERTMS) die impact hebben op de businessprocessen en dienen te worden vertaald naar IT-impact op onze services.

We ontwikkelen binnen ons cluster niet alleen technologie, maar ook onze manier van werken. Zo zetten we vol in op DevOps en dat binnen een Release Train met verschillende Agile teams en een multidisciplinaire samenstelling. Ontwikkelvermogen is een cruciale competentie binnen NS. Het stelt medewerkers in staat flexibel in te spelen op veranderingen, snel nieuwe kennis te verwerven en samen te leren. We geloven dat dit samenwerking en innovatie bevordert doordat medewerkers openstaan voor nieuwe ideeën en continu verbeteren. De werklocatie is Utrecht en wij werken in een hybride vorm, zowel op kantoor als vanuit huis.

Dit zijn de eisen

Om als technisch solution architect volwaardig te kunnen functioneren dien je hoog over de volgende vijf disciplines te beheersen:

De business en de bedrijfsstrategie doorgronden.
Sterk kunnen communiceren ("from boardroom to engine room").
Modellen en stroomdiagrammen kunnen uittekenen.
Begrijpen hoe systemen tot stand komen (projectmanagement en ontwikkelprocessen).
De organisatie inzicht geven in non-functional requirements, zoals de balans tussen security, kosten en performance.

Dit Vertaalt Zich In De Volgende Functie Eisen

WO/HBO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 5 jaar recente ervaring in een architectuur- of vergelijkbare rol.
Kennis van beheer, data- en securityrichtlijnen, en requirements engineering.
Aantoonbaar ervaring met architectuurmethoden, technieken, tools, frameworks, etc. Certificeringen zoals TOGAF en ArchiMate zijn een pré.
Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met Microsoft Azure en Azure Kubernetes Service. Certificaten van Microsoft Azure en Kubernetes zijn een pré.
Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring met Infrastructure-as-code, met name Terraform
Ervaring met Scrum, SAFe, CI/CD en DevOps (mindset en tooling). Ruimschootse ervaring met het inrichten en beheren van CI/CD pipelines is vereist, met name in Azure DevOps
Ervaring met het implementeren en inrichten van monitoringtools zoals Datadog
Kennis van netwerktechnologiën en –infrastructuur (routers, vpn’s, loadbalancers, firewalls)
Je hebt ervaring binnen grote/complexe organisaties (logistieke domein is een pré). Je bent in staat om mee te bewegen met verandering en jezelf te ontwikkelen, zeker met de komst van genAI.
Je bent coachend naar de DevOps teams en begeleidt hen in hun dagelijkse ontwikkelproces.
Met jouw flexibiliteit en vermogen om samen te werken, versterk je de teams. Je bent nieuwsgierig en staat open voor feedback. Je leert snel van fouten en ervaringen en je kan je snel aanpassen in veranderende omstandigheden. Je deelt jouw kennis en ervaring met anderen en je stimuleert anderen om te leren.

Op NS kun je rekenen

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. jobs.description:
Description

About the Client

Our client is a global leader in eye care, dedicated to improving lives by enhancing sight. With a strong portfolio of innovative products—including contact lenses, eye care solutions, and surgical instruments for cataract and retina procedures—they serve customers in over 140 countries. By advancing cutting-edge technologies and solutions, they continue to shape the future of eye health worldwide.

About The Project

As part of their ongoing innovation, our client is enhancing their medical devices with advanced connectivity features and cloud-based services. Since adoption of next-generation solutions is gradual, the project must ensure smooth integration between legacy and modern systems in real-world environments.

The mission is to design and deliver a comprehensive set of tools, services, and libraries that enable seamless interoperability of existing devices with both cloud and on-premises infrastructures. The focus is on ensuring data integrity, security, and interoperability across all systems.

Project Status

The project has successfully completed its high-level requirements definition and initial technical planning. The next stage involves detailed design, implementation, and verification & validation activities. To achieve this, our client is now scaling up the software engineering team and seeking skilled professionals to join this critical phase of development.

Requirements

Exploratory Test Engineer combines two complementary responsibilities in a split role (Scrum Master 20‑40%, Exploratory Device Testing 60‑80%). As Scrum Master, the role serves primarily the RTD FrontEnd development team and may expand to cover the VideoUnit team (approx. 20% SM capacity per team). As Exploratory Test Engineer, the role performs hands-on testing directly on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device hardware in a regulated medical device environment.

The RTD FrontEnd is a Windows x86-64 embedded system hosting multiple applications (FESupervisorApp, FEUserApp, FELogTransport, FemtoScan Service) that drive the full clinical workflow from patient selection through treatment execution. The VideoUnit is a Xilinx Zynq Ultrascale Linux system responsible for real-time image processing, eye tracking (SmartCam interface), and the Ophthalmic Digital Microscope. Both systems are safety-classified software under IEC 62304 and require rigorous test coverage. The Scrum Master is a key role responsible for enabling team effectiveness and high-quality delivery in a safety-critical, highly regulated environment.

Core Qualifications Include:

3+ years of experience in exploratory or hands-on functional software testing, ideally on real embedded hardware or medical devices.
Familiarity with Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) or comparable structured exploratory testing approaches.
Practical experience with Azure DevOps (backlog management, sprint boards, defect tracking, build/release pipelines).
Solid understanding of Windows desktop application testing (UI workflows, configuration, error handling).
Ability to read and interpret C++ application architecture and system integration diagrams for test planning purposes.
Experience working in Agile teams using feature-driven development, time-boxing, and artifact management.
Interpersonal skills with a proven ability to achieve constructive solutions in cross-departmental topics, as well as in organizing and motivating team members.
Fluent English; intermediate-level German. Onsite, Erlangen, no home office

Job responsibilities

Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies for the FrontEnd team (sprint planning, daily stand-up, sprint review, retrospective) and optionally a second team (VideoUnit).
Coach team members on Agile/Scrum principles, continuous improvement, and self-organization; act as a servant leader and team advocate.
Identify and actively remove impediments; manage cross-team dependencies and escalate blockers to management as needed.
Maintain team health metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, defect aging) and communicate progress transparently to stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with the Product Owner on backlog refinement, sprint goal clarity, and Definition of Done alignment.
Support adoption of AI-assisted development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure DevOps tooling within the team.
Facilitate continuous process improvement using retrospective data; drive Agile maturity across one or two Scrum teams.
Plan, design, and execute exploratory test sessions on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device (hardware-in-the-loop), focusing on clinical user workflows of the FrontEnd application.
Apply Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) and exploratory test charters; document findings with clear reproducibility steps and severity classification.
Collaborate with software engineers and verification engineers to triage defects; create and track issues in Azure DevOps.
Contribute to test strategy and risk-based coverage decisions alongside the Quality and Architecture team.
Produce lightweight test artifacts required under IEC 62304 (test session reports, defect records, anomaly reports) in coordination with the Quality team.
Validate integration of FrontEnd with BackEnd, VideoUnit, and Refractive Server Device (RSD) at the system level during sprint deliveries.

Flexible Opportunities:

Dentsply Sirona ist der weltweit größte Anbieter von Dentalprodukten und -technologien und kann auf mehr als ein Jahrhundert an Innovationen und Dienstleistungen für die Dentalindustrie und Patienten weltweit zurückblicken. Der Hauptsitz von Dentsply Sirona befindet sich in Charlotte, North Carolina. Die Aktien des Unternehmens sind in den Vereinigten Staaten an der NASDAQ unter dem Symbol XRAY notiert. Besuchen Sie www.dentsplysirona.com für weitere Informationen über Dentsply Sirona und seine Produkte.

Wir suchen einen Senior Software Engineer I (m/w/d), der unser Team verstärkt.
In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Leitung bei der Entwicklung und Architektur komplexer Systeme und stellen deren Skalierbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sicher. Sie arbeiten über mehrere Epics hinweg, koordinieren Features und etablieren einheitliche Refinement-Prozesse über verschiedene Teams hinweg. Dies ist eine Hybrid-Position, die eine Anwesenheit im Büro von mindestens einem Tag pro Woche erfordert.

Ihre Aufgaben

Technische Umsetzung & Entwicklung

Fördern Sie die bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zwischen Product-, UX- und Infrastruktur-Teams.
Unterstützen und coachen Sie Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler teamübergreifend als technischer Mentor und Berater.
Führen Sie neue Technologien ein und treiben deren Nutzung voran, um die Effizienz der Softwareentwicklung zu steigern.
Übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für Incident-Response-Prozesse und sorgen Sie für die Ausfallsicherheit der Systeme.

Projektumfang & Komplexität

Leiten Sie die Umsetzung über mehrere Epics hinweg und koordinieren Sie verschiedene Features, um ein konsistentes Refinement sicherzustellen.
Steuern und begleiten Sie den Epic-Refinement-Prozess zur effektiven Abstimmung mehrerer Features über unterschiedliche Teams hinweg.

Kommunikation & Wirkung

Präsentieren Sie komplexe technische Strategien gegenüber unterschiedlichen Stakeholder-Gruppen.
Fördern Sie die Abstimmung und Einigkeit bei technischen Entscheidungen über mehrere Teams hinweg.

Führung & Weiterentwicklung

Bieten Sie unternehmensweite technische Unterstützung und Mentoring.
Geben Sie die architektonische Ausrichtung vor und unterstützen Sie wichtige technische Entscheidungen.

Ihr Profil

Ausbildung

Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Physik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet beziehungsweise eine gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

Berufserfahrung & Qualifikationen

4 bis 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.
Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer technischer Projekte über mehrere Teams hinweg.
Erfahrung mit mehreren Programmiersprachen wie Golang, C++ oder Flutter/Dart.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Systemarchitektur sowie Skalierbarkeit von Softwarelösungen.
Erfahrung im Mentoring von Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern über verschiedene Teams hinweg.
Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen (Distributed Systems).
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung technischer Strategien ist von Vorteil.
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten ist ein Plus.
Nachweisbare Erfolge bei Architekturentscheidungen sind wünschenswert.

About the Role:

We are recruiting a talented Senior .Net Engineer on behalf of our client, a leading global food-tech and delivery platform in London. In this core backend engineering position, you will design, build, and optimize high-throughput, mission-critical microservices and distributed transaction systems supporting millions of real-time orders daily.

Key Responsibilities:

Architect, implement, and maintain resilient backend services and REST/gRPC APIs using modern C# / .NET Core technologies.
Design scalable, event-driven distributed architectures capable of handling peak mealtime traffic surges with low latency.
Optimize database performance and query efficiency across relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (Redis, MongoDB) databases.
Champion engineering excellence, writing clean, maintainable, test-driven code (TDD) with comprehensive automated test coverage.
Collaborate within cross-functional agile squads with Product Managers, UX Designers, and QA engineers to deliver robust consumer features.

Solid understanding of software design patterns, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and SOLID principles.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and monitoring tools (Datadog, Prometheus).

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer
to join a small, highly experienced Epicor Labs team that transforms innovative AI concepts into enterprise-grade products trusted by enterprise customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role
, not a management position. You will design and build, set the technical bar for production quality, and provide the architectural judgement needed to take AI-driven products from promising prototype to something enterprise customers can trust with their business data.

What You'll Do

As a Principal Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing and delivering the next generation of AI capabilities across Epicor's ERP portfolio.

PoCs and MVPs in AI transformation projects inside enterprise ERP software - rapid exploration of new capabilities, with the engineering discipline to evolve the successful ones into production-grade services.
Cloud platform services - designing and building the services, APIs, and data layers that new AI capabilities run on, integrating with large, established ERP products.
Production readiness - bringing R&D output up to enterprise standard: reliability, observability, security, multi-tenancy, and safe failure behaviour.
AI engineering - integrating LLMs and agentic patterns into business software responsibly: guardrails, permissions, auditability, and designing for the probabilistic nature of AI components acting on real business data.
Raising the bar - architectural review across the team's workstreams, mentoring engineers at all levels, and turning good judgement into standards and automation rather than tribal knowledge.

What You Are Likely To Bring

Principal-level engineering depth in C#/.NET and/or Python, with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), and a strong record of designing and shipping production services. Our systems span both stacks - strength in one with working fluency in the other is the expectation.
Production TypeScript/JavaScript frontend engineering experience, including building secure, accessible user interfaces that integrate with enterprise web shells, APIs and backend services.
Experience designing and integrating enterprise information systems, with a strong understanding of data flows, system boundaries and the operational impact of change.
Ability to work effectively with data scientists and other AI specialists to turn data, models and experimentation into reliable, usable product capabilities.
Production ownership experience - you have run systems in production and carry the instincts that come from it: partial failure, resilience, blast-radius thinking, and designing for the incident nobody planned. This matters to us more than any specific framework.
Distributed-systems fluency: service boundaries, transactional thinking, multi-tenant design, API design and versioning.
Strong architectural communication - able to explain, document, and defend design decisions across teams, and to review others' designs constructively.
Pragmatism under real-world constraints: comfortable integrating with large, long-lived enterprise systems and choosing the achievable-good over the theoretical-perfect.

Highly Desirable

Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted engineering - building with LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, and prompt-driven workflows, and a grounded view of where they help and where they don't.
Experience taking early-stage products (PoC/MVP) to production, ideally in enterprise software.
AWS experience.
Complex business-domain experience - ERP, e-commerce, finance, logistics - and an appreciation of the cost of getting business data wrong.
Security instincts: least privilege, tenancy isolation, trust boundaries.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 3 months, you'll:

Deliver production-quality code
Own components from design through implementation
Contribute architectural improvements across the team

Within 6–12 Months, You'll

Lead the design of major platform capabilities
Become a trusted technical leader and architectural reference point
Mentor engineers and help raise engineering standards across Epicor Labs

About Epicor Labs

Epicor Labs is the innovation engine behind AI transformation across Epicor's ERP portfolio.

Our team explores new ideas, rapidly prototypes solutions, and turns successful concepts into production-ready capabilities before handing them over to product engineering teams.

We're a Small, Senior Team With

High autonomy
Minimal bureaucracy
Fast decision-making
Strong engineering standards
A collaborative culture where the best ideas win, regardless of title

You'll work alongside experienced architects, product managers, UX designers, and AI specialists to solve challenging technical problems with real customer impact.

Technology

C# / .NET
Python
Azure
TypeScript / JavaScript
REST & GraphQL APIs
Relational & document databases
GitHub with CI/CD pipelines
LLM APIs
AI-assisted development tools

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

Competitive Pay & Benefits

Health and Wellness: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
Internal Mobility: Opportunities for mentorship, continuing education, and focused career goal setting, with 25% of positions filled internally.
Career Development: Free LinkedIn Learning licenses for everyone, along with our Mentoring Program to boost your personal development.
Education Support: Geographically specific programs to balance the cost of education with the benefits of continued learning and personal development.
Inclusive Workplace: Collaborate with a diverse team in an inclusive, global workplace that fosters innovation and celebrates partnership.
Work-Life Balance: Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.
Global Mobility: Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer. 

Recruiter

Alena Jelinkova

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer - Investments

About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products - Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution - we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.

Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

The role & team

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.

The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.

On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

What You'll Do

Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
Contribute to frontend code (React + TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
Use AI actively in your day-to-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

What We're Looking For

6+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs
Strong understanding of data modelling, event-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast-growing startup
AI-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

Why join us?

Technically interesting problem - pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised
Modern stack - .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event-driven
Agency - we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
Customer proximity - you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
High-quality culture - we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
Impact from day one - we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
AI-first - we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

Our hiring process

Introductory call (30 mins): a casual chat with one or two of our product team
Technical interview (90 mins): a collaborative, open-book session with two engineers, working through a real-world problem together
Call with founders (30 mins): we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
Final response: we'll follow up promptly with next steps

Kota Benefits

Health insurance via Kota
Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
WFH stipend to support your home office setup
Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
Access to office space in Dublin or a co-working space, wherever you're based
Flexible working hours, we're remote-first with some fixed hours for team alignment

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
At a glance

Location:
Cambridge

In-office expectation:
Once every two weeks

Employment type:
Permanent

Salary:
£55,000-£80,000

This role will be a mid or senior level engineer dependant on experience

Why this role exists

Redgate's Foundry is our innovation incubator, the team scanning the horizon for Redgate's next big opportunity. This role exists because that kind of work needs engineers who are genuinely excited by discovery: people who can form a hypothesis, test it fast, and make a clear-eyed call on whether to push forward or change course.

Most ideas won't become products. That's by design. Each experiment sharpens our thinking and improves the odds of finding the one that will. If you're motivated by that kind of challenge, where the destination isn't fixed and the work is never the same twice, this is the role for you.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organisations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert plus agent company: domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match. AI handles the heavy lifting, and our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.

Why join our engineering team?

You'll work in a team that cares about collaboration, craft and quality, not just in how we build, but in choosing what to build, finding the shortest path to the questions that matter most.
There’s real scope to grow your skills and impact, with clear pathways and support.
We value sustainable delivery, good ways of working and time to improve how we build.

About The Role

The Foundry operates differently to the rest of Redgate's product teams. You won't be handed a roadmap. Instead, you'll work across the full arc of innovation — from horizon-scanning and ideation through to early-stage research, rapid prototyping, and working directly with customers to validate what you're building.

You'll be part of a small cross-functional team (a Tech Lead plus four to six Software and Machine Learning Engineers), and you'll regularly run projects in parallel: contributing to ongoing experiments while also exploring entirely new directions. The tech stack is deliberately varied, the right tool for the job, not a fixed list, spanning C#, TypeScript, Python, and more across desktop, web, API, database, and ML development.

What makes this role different:

You'll work on problems where there is no established answer and you'll have the autonomy to explore them seriously.
Your work sits at the intersection of software engineering, customer insight, and product thinking; it's rare to find all three in one role.
You'll use and help shape how Redgate adopts agentic coding and AI development tools, not as an afterthought, but as a core part of how the team works.
The scope is genuinely broad: a typical day could see you balancing technical prototypes, customer interviews, and competitor teardowns.

What makes you a great fit

Proven experience using AI coding tools. You've used them extensively, understand their limitations, and have developed ways to work around them productively and safely.
Strong software design and coding skills across modern languages, particularly C#, TypeScript, or Python, enough to guide and review AI-generated code with confidence.
Hands-on experience building agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, Microsoft Agentic Framework, or MCP, with a solid understanding of LLM capabilities and risks.
Experience designing and running experiments to validate ideas quickly, using technical prototypes, customer feedback, and lean startup principles to test assumptions and make clear decisions.
Comfortable engaging directly with customers and stakeholders: running interviews, demos, and concierge-style validation processes, and communicating findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A product mindset; you think in terms of user value, outcomes, and market fit, not just features or technical delivery.

What we offer

Salary range: £55,000-£80,000

Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office

Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off

Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression

Private health insurance

What happens next

Your application will be reviewed by a person, we don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications. Every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You'll hear back within a few days, whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

Our interview process is straightforward and consistent, you'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

jobs.description:
Position Description

At CGI, you’ll turn complex public safety challenges into technology solutions that create tangible value for clients and the communities they serve. As a Technical Delivery Engineer within our Public Safety Business Unit, you’ll work directly with clients, operational users and CGI teams to move rapidly from problem to prototype, pilot and proven outcome. You’ll have the freedom to take ownership, explore creative approaches using modern cloud, software, data and AI capabilities, and apply sound engineering judgement in highly secure environments. Supported by a collaborative community of experts, you’ll help shape solutions across borders, emergency services and other public safety organisations, testing ideas quickly and identifying innovations with the potential to make a lasting difference.

CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go.

Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This is a hybrid position.

Your future duties and responsibilities

In this role, you will combine hands-on engineering with a pragmatic consulting mindset to solve real operational challenges. Working closely with clients, users and CGI colleagues, you will take ownership of problems from initial discovery through to working prototypes, MVPs and pilots. You’ll translate complex needs into practical solutions across applications, APIs, data, cloud and AI, balancing pace and experimentation with the security, quality and engineering judgement required in public safety environments.

You will have scope to explore new ideas, test them directly with users and adapt your approach based on evidence. Working within a supportive, agile team, you’ll contribute to workshops, demonstrations and early-stage opportunities while helping successful innovations transition into longer-term delivery.

Discover & Define – Work directly with clients, operational users and stakeholders to understand challenges, needs and opportunities.
Prototype & Deliver – Turn ideas and business challenges into working prototypes, MVPs and client pilots.
Design & Build – Develop solutions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud technologies.
Cloud & Deploy – Build and deploy solutions primarily using Microsoft Azure and modern cloud services.
Integrate & Connect – Bring together enterprise systems, APIs, data sources and third-party services.
Innovate & Automate – Apply AI, including generative AI, LLMs, RAG and automation, where it delivers meaningful value.
Test & Evolve – Validate ideas with users, gather evidence and rapidly improve solutions.
Secure & Sustain – Ensure solutions are secure, maintainable and suitable for real-world operational environments.
Engage & Demonstrate – Contribute technical expertise to client workshops, demonstrations, discussions and emerging opportunities.
Scale & Share – Capture reusable approaches and support the transition of successful solutions into wider delivery teams.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

You should be an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and turning ideas into working technology. You’ll need broad technical capability, with depth in at least one area, alongside the confidence to engage directly with technical and non-technical clients. You should be curious about emerging technologies, comfortable making informed decisions and able to balance speed, security and quality. You’ll be supported by colleagues while having the autonomy to own outcomes, experiment with new approaches and continuously develop your expertise.

Strong software engineering experience, with evidence of designing, building and deploying working applications.
Broad full-stack knowledge, with experience across several areas of the technology stack and depth in at least one.
Strong proficiency in relevant technologies, such as React or Angular and Python, TypeScript, C#, Java or comparable languages.
Experience with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Good understanding of APIs, systems integration and modern software engineering practices.
Practical experience or exposure to AI-enabled applications, including generative AI or LLMs.
Proven client-facing or consulting capability, with confidence communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including translating business and operational challenges into practical technical solutions.
Proven ability to work with ambiguity, take ownership and make decisions without continuous direction.
Ability to balance pace, quality, security and pragmatism within complex delivery environments.
Experience with Azure OpenAI/OpenAI, RAG, AI agents, automation, data engineering, computer vision, SQL or AI-assisted development would be advantageous.
Experience developing prototypes or MVPs, or working within public sector, public safety or regulated environments, would also be beneficial.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Y

Job Description:

Job Summary

We are looking for a Product Engineer to join our AI Search and Retrieval Context Engineering as we build the next generation of legal AI experiences for law firms.

This is not a traditional front-end developer role where requirements are handed over and built from a specification. It is a hands-on product engineering role for someone who can understand the problem, shape the user experience, think through the system design and then build high-quality software.

The role is primarily focused on React, TypeScript and modern user experience development, but the expectation is broader than UI delivery. You will work close to lawyers, knowledge teams, innovation teams and technical stakeholders to understand how AI search, retrieval and agents should fit into real legal workflows.

We are not building another disconnected AI chatbot. We are building trusted AI experiences that sit on top of the firm’s own documents, knowledge, matters, metadata and workflows.

As a Product Engineer, you will help turn complex AI retrieval capability into simple, useful and trusted experiences for lawyers.

Why This Role Matters

AI is changing software engineering. The value of an engineer is no longer only in writing code quickly. AI can now help generate code, tests and components at speed. That makes the human part of engineering more important, not less.

The best engineers are now the ones who understand the system, the user, the constraints and the business problem.

For this team, that means understanding why a lawyer is searching, what they need to trust an answer, what happens if the wrong document is surfaced, how permissions work, how citations should be displayed, and how the experience fits into their daily workflow.

A button is not just a button. A search result is not just a card. An AI answer is not just text on a page.

In legal AI, every interaction has to support trust, explainability, security and adoption.

That is why we need Product Engineers: people who are fluent in engineering, fluent in product thinking, and willing to understand the domain deeply enough to build the right thing.

About The Team

The Search & AI team helps law firms build secure, firm-specific AI capabilities on top of their existing document, knowledge and matter infrastructure.

We work with firms that want to move beyond standalone AI tools and create a trusted AI layer inside their own environment. Our solutions typically connect to systems such as iManage, SharePoint, NetDocuments, Microsoft 365, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI and internal knowledge platforms.

The team already has experience delivering AI search and workflow capabilities for a Magic Circle law firm and a global multinational law firm, including natural language search, agents and Azure-based retrieval solutions built in partnership with Microsoft.

As the market shifts from AI adoption to AI ownership, our team is becoming more like a Forward Deployment Engineering function: technical people who work close to strategic clients, understand their workflows, and build real solutions that move from prototype to production.

The Role

You will design and build the product experience layer for legal AI.

That includes search interfaces, AI answer experiences, document previews, citation views, agent workflows, feedback loops, dashboards, admin screens and embedded components for tools lawyers already use.

You will mainly work in React and TypeScript, building polished, enterprise-grade applications that are fast, accessible, secure and suitable for professional legal users.

You will work with AI engineers, retrieval architects, Azure engineers, legal knowledge experts and client stakeholders to turn complex technical capabilities into clear, usable products.

What You Will Build

You may build a natural language search experience that allows lawyers to ask questions across a firm’s knowledge bank and receive grounded answers with citations.

You may create a source preview panel that lets a lawyer inspect the exact document behind an AI answer before relying on it.

You may design an agent workflow where a lawyer can run a research task, review retrieved documents, refine the question, compare outputs and export the result.

You may build dashboards that show search quality, adoption, answer confidence, feedback trends and retrieval performance.

You may create embedded components for SharePoint, Teams, Word, Outlook or a firm intranet, so AI appears inside the workflow rather than as another destination.

The common thread is that you will be building the experience layer that makes AI usable, explainable and trusted.

Key Responsibilities

Build high-quality React and TypeScript applications

You will build modern front-end applications using React, TypeScript and strong component design. You will care about performance, accessibility, responsiveness, error handling, loading states, empty states, maintainability and the overall quality of the user experience. You will work with APIs, authentication, permissions, search services, AI responses, document metadata and workflow actions.

Shape the product, not just the code

You will help define how legal AI experiences should work. This means challenging unclear requirements, simplifying complex workflows, proposing better interaction patterns and making sure the team is building something users will actually adopt. You will not just wait for a perfect specification. You will help create it.

Understand the lawyer workflow

You will work close to legal users and client teams to understand how lawyers search for knowledge, review documents, validate answers and move through their work. The goal is to build AI into workflows lawyers already understand, rather than sending them to another disconnected tool.

Turn AI retrieval into trusted UX

You will design interfaces that make retrieval transparent. This includes citations, source previews, metadata, snippets, filters, document cards, confidence signals, feedback mechanisms and audit-friendly interaction patterns. In legal AI, the user needs to understand where an answer came from and why it should be trusted.

Work across the system

Although this is mainly a React and TypeScript role, you will need to understand how your UI fits into the wider system. That may include Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, retrieval APIs, MCP-style tool access, document processing pipelines, security trimming, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, iManage or other enterprise systems. You do not need to own every layer, but you should understand how the layers connect.

Use AI as part of your engineering workflow

We expect Product Engineers to use AI effectively in their own work. That may include using AI to generate code drafts, test ideas, explore components, accelerate refactoring or support documentation. But the judgement remains yours. AI can help write code. It cannot own the product intent, system consequences or user trust.

Required Skills

You should have strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript.

You should be comfortable building component-based applications, working with APIs, handling complex state and delivering polished enterprise user interfaces. Experience with Next.js would be useful, but is not essential.

You should understand modern front-end development practices, including authentication flows, role-based permissions, asynchronous data, loading states, error states, accessibility, testing, source control and CI/CD.

Experience with some of the following would be valuable: React Query, Zustand, Redux, Tailwind, Fluent UI, Material UI, Vite, Next.js, Storybook, Playwright, Jest, Azure Static Web Apps, Azure App Service or Microsoft Graph.

You do not need to be a deep AI engineer, but you should be interested in AI product design and willing to learn how retrieval, citations, agents and RAG systems work.

Product Engineering Mindset

The strongest candidates will think beyond tickets.

You should be someone who wants to understand why something is being built, not just how to build it. You should be comfortable working in ambiguity, forming a point of view, testing ideas quickly and improving based on feedback.

You should care about systems. You should want to understand how the UI, API, retrieval layer, permissions model and user workflow fit together.

You should be able to see where a small UI decision could create confusion, risk or unnecessary friction.

You should also care about product quality. Legal users are time-poor and sceptical of poor AI experiences. The interface needs to be clear, reliable and professional.

This is a role for someone who wants to use engineering judgement, product instinct and domain understanding together.

AI and Search Awareness

You will work around AI search and retrieval systems, so you should be interested in concepts such as retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, vector search, hybrid search, document chunking, citations, source grounding, prompt workflows and agentic interfaces.

You do not need to build all of this from scratch, but you do need to understand enough to design good user experiences around it.

For example, when an AI answer is shown, the UI should help the lawyer answer practical questions: Where did this answer come from? Can I open the source? Is this the latest version? Which jurisdiction does this relate to? Who authored it? Can I trust this document? What should I do next?

That is product engineering in legal AI.

Desirable Experience

Experience in any of the following would be useful: legal technology, enterprise search, document management systems, knowledge management, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, iManage, NetDocuments, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, SaaS products, internal tools, workflow platforms or professional services.

Experience building search interfaces, AI interfaces, dashboards, document review tools, knowledge portals or workflow applications would be particularly relevant.

What Success Looks Like

Success means the team builds AI products that lawyers actually use.

A successful search experience will help a lawyer find the right precedent, legal opinion or knowledge document quickly and confidently.

A successful answer experience will make the source material visible, citeable and easy to inspect.

A successful agent workflow will guide the user through a complex task without hiding important decisions.

A successful product will feel simple on the surface, even though the system underneath is complex.

More broadly, success means helping law firms move from AI experimentation to AI capability they can trust, own and scale.

Example Projects

A legal knowledge search application over SharePoint or iManage content.
A React/TypeScript AI answer interface with citations, filters and source previews.
A document preview panel showing metadata, snippets and highlighted evidence.
An agent workflow for precedent discovery, matter research or legal opinion search.
A dashboard showing adoption, answer quality, feedback and retrieval performance.
An embedded SharePoint or Teams component that brings AI search into an existing lawyer workflow.
A configuration experience for managing sources, prompts, retrieval settings or access controls.
A feedback interface that helps improve retrieval quality over time.

W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy naprawdę wspiera człowieka. Nasz dział Cloud and Application rozwija rozwiązania IT, które pomagają firmom produkcyjnym działać mądrzej – dzięki danym, automatyzacji i sztucznej inteligencji w praktycznym wydaniu.

Czerpiemy z doświadczenia Etteplanu w inżynierii, dokumentacji technicznej i automatyzacji, tworząc aplikacje, które łączą świat IT z rzeczywistymi procesami przemysłowymi.

Z fińską prostotą podchodzimy do rozwiązywania problemów – bez zbędnych warstw i skomplikowanych procedur. Liczy się współpraca, zaufanie i wspólne poszukiwanie lepszych sposobów działania.

Tworzymy i wdrażamy nowoczesne systemy MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems)
, które pomagają największym producentom na świecie digitalizować procesy produkcyjne. Specjalizujemy się w branżach spożywczej
i chemicznej
, pracując w oparciu o rozwiązania AVEVA
– m.in. Platforma Systemowa, Model-Driven MES i Historian.

W związku z rozwojem naszego działu poszukujemy osoby, która chce rozpocząć karierę w świecie cyfrowej produkcji jako MES Developer
.

Dlaczego warto?

Ta rola to wyjątkowa szansa, by połączyć pasję do programowania z praktycznym wpływem na przemysł
. Zobaczysz, jak Twoje rozwiązania usprawniają realne linie produkcyjne i wpływają na codzienną pracę tysięcy ludzi. Jeśli chcesz rozwijać się w kierunku integracji IT i automatyki – to idealne miejsce, by zacząć.

Nasza firma specjalizuje się w integracji technologii IT z produkcją przemysłową, koncentrując się głównie na branży spożywczej i chemicznej. Współpracujemy z największymi firmami produkcyjnymi na całym świecie, wdrażając innowacyjne rozwiązania oparte na platformie Systemowej oraz Model-Driven MES od AVEVA.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

kierowanie procesem tworzenia, konfiguracji i wdrażania nowoczesnych systemów produkcji cyfrowej,
współpracę z klientami w celu zbierania i przekładania wymagań dotyczących projektów i usprawniania procesów na szczegółową dokumentację projektową,
projektowanie i rozwój baz danych w Microsoft SQL Server i/lub Oracle,
tworzenie i rozwój interfejsów użytkownika w Angular, C#, JavaScript i ASP.Net Core,
projektowanie i opracowywanie raportów produkcyjnych w AVEVA Historian,
zapewnienie wsparcia technicznego i operacyjnego automatyzacji dla działów inżynierii, produkcji czy utrzymania ruchu,
koordynowanie i wspieranie działań związanych z uruchamianiem projektów,
mentorowanie i szkolenie młodszych inżynierów,
budowanie i utrzymywanie silnych relacji partnerskich z zespołami projektowymi i klientami w celu identyfikacji obszarów do poprawy procesów poprzez technologię automatyzacji i analizy danych,
badanie nowych technologii i trendów w produkcji cyfrowej.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

posiadasz ponad 3-letnie doświadczenie jako inżynier produkcji cyfrowej, szczególnie z produktami AVEVA (Wonderware) (IDE, MES (Performance Operations, Quality), Batch, WEI, itp.),
masz doświadczenie w projektowaniu i rozwoju baz danych w Microsoft SQL Server i/lub Oracle,
umiesz projektować i rozwijać interfejsy użytkownika w Angular, C#, JavaScript i/lub ASP.Net Core,
posiadasz umiejętności programowania webowego, w tym JavaScript, CSS, JSON, JQuery, Web API, HTML5 i/lub REST API,
komunikacja w języku angielskim nie sprawia Ci problemu (poziom B2/C1).

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie w tworzeniu raportów w AVEVA Historian lub podobnym narzędziu,
znajomość Skelta BPM / AVEVA Work Tasks,
umiejętności programowania PLC/HMI/SCADA, szczególnie w systemach Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider itp.,
doświadczenie w pracy z systemami automatyzacji w przemyśle spożywczym lub farmaceutycznym.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

The opportunity

We are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious system architect to take on the responsibility for defining and governing the architecture, processes, methods, and infrastructure required to verify and validate industrial control systems throughout their lifecycle.

The role ensures that testability, observability, diagnostics, cybersecurity, reliability, and quality are systematically engineered into control system architectures, enabling continuous validation from concept and design through deployment, operation, maintenance, modernization, and retirement. The architect drives lifecycle testing, automated verification, digital validation environments, and quality-by-design practices across control platforms and solutions.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Define and govern the overall Verification & Validation (V&V) architecture, strategy, standards, and governance framework.
Establish validation approaches for controllers, protection systems, automation applications, HMI/SCADA, communication networks, and integrations.
Define verification gates, acceptance criteria, traceability, and release readiness requirements.
Lead DFMEA activities across systems, subsystems, components, interfaces, and control functions, translating risks into requirements and test cases.
Ensure design for testability, enabling validation of critical safety, reliability, and performance scenarios.
Define and verify preventive and detective controls, including diagnostics, protections, interlocks, alarms, monitoring, and fallback behaviors.
Govern lifecycle testing, including unit, integration, system, acceptance, regression, upgrade, and operational validation.
Drive test automation through CI/CD, automated test frameworks, SIL/HIL simulation, virtual commissioning, and Digital Twin environments.
Ensure end-to-end traceability between requirements, architecture, test evidence, defects, releases, and compliance obligations.
Act as the technical authority for V&V, quality engineering, cybersecurity validation, and continuous improvement, while mentoring cross-functional teams.

Your background

PhD or Master’s degree in Control Systems, Real-Time Systems, Industrial Automation, Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field, combined with advanced knowledge of control architectures, industrial automation, cyber-physical systems, and systems engineering principles.
10+ years of experience in control systems, industrial automation, power systems, or other mission-critical industrial platforms.
Proven experience defining Verification & Validation (V&V) architectures for control systems and tailoring software development and verification lifecycles to product-specific software and hardware requirements.
Hands-on expertise in verification, validation, test automation, systems integration, and control system lifecycle management.
Strong knowledge of Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA, HMI, PLC, DCS, Protection & Control Systems, and systems engineering methodologies.
Experience with V&V methodologies and advanced validation environments, including UT, SIT, SVT, FAT, SAT, Release Validation, SIL, HIL, Real-Time Simulation, Digital Twins, and Virtual Commissioning.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer - Investments

About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products - Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution - we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.

Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

The role & team

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.

The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.

On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

What You'll Do

Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
Contribute to frontend code (React + TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
Use AI actively in your day-to-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

What We're Looking For

6+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs
Strong understanding of data modelling, event-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast-growing startup
AI-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

Why join us?

Technically interesting problem - pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised
Modern stack - .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event-driven
Agency - we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
Customer proximity - you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
High-quality culture - we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
Impact from day one - we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
AI-first - we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

Our hiring process

Introductory call (30 mins): a casual chat with one or two of our product team
Technical interview (90 mins): a collaborative, open-book session with two engineers, working through a real-world problem together
Call with founders (30 mins): we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
Final response: we'll follow up promptly with next steps

Kota Benefits

Health insurance via Kota
Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
WFH stipend to support your home office setup
Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
Access to office space in Dublin or a co-working space, wherever you're based
Flexible working hours, we're remote-first with some fixed hours for team alignment
